verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs explicitly confirm repository creation/management and commit history/code browsing (gitea-docs-1, gitea-docs-3), and this core Git hosting capability is corroborated by extensive hands-on community usage across multiple deployments (gitea-comm-1, gitea-comm-3, gitea-comm-7, gitea-comm-8, gitea-comm-13, gitea-comm-14). Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of commit-history browsing performance at scale (one comment notes slow Activity feed loading, gitea-comm-10) and no first-party API/OpenAPI docs surfaced to verify programmatic repo management.
